purpose: Discover public funder and grant records relevant to NeuroAI systems via offline fixture or replay pages. Does not infer control from capital.
inclusion: Public NIH / funder award records with durable award identifiers
Public patents-and-grants corpus rows when identity keys are exact
exclusion: Inferring ownership control, governance authority, or system capability from funding alone
Treating capital events as regulatory authorization
Live HTTP inside the discovery package

identity_key.name: award_or_grant_id
identity_key.match_rule: Exact award or grant identifier. Distinct award IDs must not fuzzy-merge.

denominator_policy: Caller-supplied result-set size is a raw denominator. It is not funding-universe completeness.
pagination_policy: Terminal pagination must be explicit. Missing continuation on non-final pages fails closed.
known_identity_reconciliation: Optional award id to source_id map. Exact matches emit DUPLICATE.
cadence: Human-gated. Offline fixture/replay only in this programme maturity.
raw_input_boundary: Caller supplies already-retrieved grant payloads. Discovery has no embedded live HTTP client.
human_review_path: Candidate proposals remain PENDING_HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE until adjudicate_candidate_source.

evaluation.precision_method: Sampled human review of NEW candidates (not executed by this software).

boundary: SU-GRANTS offline programme execution emits candidates and coverage. Funding evidence is not control, capability, or authorization.
